BiblicalUsage: Sheariah was a son of Azel, a Benjamite of the family of Saul, one of six sons named in the genealogy, and the same list is repeated in the next chapter. His name means valued by Jehovah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being valued by Jehovah is the whole of Sheariah's story. He is named twice among his brothers, and I hold that God values the men the world forgets.
